name.description: The project's name. Default: its folder's.

entry.description: The page the app opens on, by id (its file name in pages/). Default: home, else the first page.

theme.description: Design tokens and settings: colours, fonts, sizes, the icon library and the page transition.

transitions.description: Pages' own transitions, by page id.

upskale.description: An Upskale business's API: Tenant.… and Client.… data, and the storefront components.

api.description: The business's API address. Empty: sample data.

store.description: Pins the app to one store (id or slug).
